            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_comp_m280_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_m280_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ae_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 1
            CHOICE = scope:zg361_comp_route
            OPERATION_ID = 280
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_financial_applied value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_financial_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m280_receipt_active value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m280_route value = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m280_value value = 0 }
                if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m280_value value = 1 } }
                else_if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m280_value value = -1 } }
                zg361_comp_m280_consume_effect = yes
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:zg361_comp_m280_receipt_active = 1
                var:zg361_comp_m280_receipt_owner = var:zg361_case_ae_owner
                var:zg361_comp_m280_receipt_subject = this
                var:zg361_comp_m280_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m280_receipt_case = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m280_receipt_state = 1
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_m280_receipt_route = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 2 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_typed_red value = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = -1 }
            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 3 } }
    }
}

zg361_comp_m280_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ae_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ae_subject

                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_case_serial

                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
            var:zg361_comp_m280_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_comp_m280_consumed = 0

        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m280_object_materialized value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m280_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_ae_owner }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m280_object_subject value = this }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m280_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m280_object_case value = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m280_object_state value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m280_object_route value = var:zg361_comp_m280_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m280_visible_outcome value = var:zg361_comp_m280_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m280_visible_revision value = var:zg361_case_ae_revision }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m280_rule value = var:zg361_comp_m280_route }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m280_service_months value = 12 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m280_proration_bps value = 10000 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m280_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m280_proration_bps value = 5000 } }
            else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m280_route = 3 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m280_proration_bps value = 0 } }

        zg361_comp_ae_recalculate_statement_effect = yes

        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m280_consumed value = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = zg361_pp_m147_receipt_active
                var:zg361_pp_m147_receipt_active = 1
                has_variable = zg361_pp_m147_consumed
                var:zg361_pp_m147_consumed = 1
                has_variable = zg361_pp_m147_receipt_owner
                var:zg361_pp_m147_receipt_owner = var:zg361_comp_result_owner
                has_variable = zg361_pp_m147_receipt_subject
                var:zg361_pp_m147_receipt_subject = var:zg361_comp_result_subject
                has_variable = zg361_pp_m147_receipt_cycle
                var:zg361_pp_m147_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_comp_result_cycle
                has_variable = zg361_pp_m147_receipt_serial
                var:zg361_pp_m147_receipt_serial = var:zg361_comp_result_case
                has_variable = zg361_pp_m147_receipt_revision
                var:zg361_pp_m147_receipt_revision > 0
                var:zg361_comp_m280_receipt_active = 1
                var:zg361_comp_m280_consumed = 1
                var:zg361_comp_m280_visible_revision > 0
            }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_promotion_receipt_active value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_promotion_receipt_posted value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_promotion_receipt_owner value = var:zg361_comp_result_owner }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_promotion_receipt_subject value = var:zg361_comp_result_subject }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_promotion_receipt_cycle value = var:zg361_comp_result_cycle }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_promotion_receipt_case value = var:zg361_comp_result_case }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_promotion_receipt_choice_serial value = var:zg361_pp_m147_receipt_serial }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_promotion_receipt_serial value = var:zg361_pp_m147_receipt_serial }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_promotion_receipt_choice_revision value = var:zg361_pp_m147_receipt_revision }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_promotion_receipt_revision value = var:zg361_comp_m280_visible_revision }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_promotion_receipt_operation value = 280 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_promotion_receipt_route value = var:zg361_comp_m280_receipt_route }
